name: Sunward Phalanx
headerMeta: Golden era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 295 leadership · Seasonal (S19: Alexander)
pitch: A premier point-holder that deletes cavalry and anything without block the moment it braces. Never flank or solo it — overlap with Modao, keep the models spread, and leave it home on far-spawn maps; its one real enemy is a Bastard Sword mount ult.

doctrines.name: Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine
doctrines.effect: 12% lifesteal for 6s after dealing damage, +12% DMG when HP above 60%.

doctrines.name: Epic Polearm Doctrine
doctrines.note: oneshots hero divers, turn 180° and re-brace if flanked — house benches it for cav-kill priority {3}

doctrines.name: Anti-Cavalry Doctrine
doctrines.effect: -30% to -35% DMG taken from cavalry while bracing (tier varies by card copy).
doctrines.note: −35% DMG taken; skippable — bottom-vet mitigation already suffices {2}

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Consistent in every scenario; with brace + cav-reduction nodes reaches 20% infantry / 65% cavalry mitigation. Two sources agree.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Viable alternative — occasional burst spikes, less consistent.

battleRole.positioning: Sit one pike-length behind your front line and control distance — never lead with it; set brace range accounting for enemy long pikes. {2} In overlap play, spread the models and sit them on your Modaos — good in overlap, not solo. {3}
battleRole.formation: Default F1 (spread): CC only disables part of the line, the rest keeps fighting. {2} F2 (block) only in narrow terrain that denies flanks, to concentrate center damage. {2}
battleRole.tips: Blue bar eats exactly one CC (even hero ults), then needs 30s out of combat — expect the second, timed CC. {2} Take it on defence 15-starts (spawn with it or supply-pull nearby); skip far-spawn maps — among the slowest units even with mobility doctrine. {3}

cards.name: Bastard Sword
cards.why: mount ult knocks the braced line, cav rides over — spacing denies it

cards.name: Modao
cards.why: overlap anchor — sit spread on them

matchups.pressure: You pressure: Iron Reapers, Azaps, Varangian Guards — each cites Phalanx range; Claymores conditionally ("depending on how they play").

controls.notes: Instant brace (1 → V) — pikes drop with CC applied immediately; ramming while braced adds zero damage. {2} Pike rotation (V) — every model faces the nearest enemy, ~doubles contact. {2} Ares' Flurry (2) — big damage, forces overextension; advance backwards after. {2} Double-C brace: 3–4× area coverage, minimal DPS loss. {1} Anti-BS counter: advance backwards → X (cancels pike animation) → long-press V on the Bastard Sword. {3}

gaps: A StarBurst house card ('Sunward Phalanx: Titanic', 2024-09-16) is known to exist, but we don't have its contents - it would outrank Amya's guide for the build if it turns up.
Skill-2 name unarbitrated: 'Ares' Flurry' (Amya) vs 'Area's Fury' (Herlajis transcript).
